The "input" of each vector already reflects that round trip (key order and dropped nulls); semantics for the server are identical to sending the raw file. expectedConventions.keys: JSONPath-like keys ($.objetos[0].erros[0].code); 'httpStatus' is the HTTP status; '$.x.length()' = array size; '$' = whole body; 'body' = exact raw response body text; 'header:<Name>' = response header; for unit vectors: 'throws' (fully-qualified exception class, exact class — AssertJ isExactlyInstanceOf), 'noException' ('true' = must not throw), 'result' (return value), 'resourceExists' (test precondition: fixture file exists), and '$...' paths over the returned object (or, with 'throws', over the thrown exception: '$.erros' = ErrosCalculoException.getErros()).
expectedConventions.values: all expected values are strings; JSON booleans/numbers compared by their JSON text unless a matcher is used.
expectedConventions.<4xx>: status in 400..499 (status().is4xxClientError()) — the exact status is not asserted upstream
expectedConventions.<num:X>: numeric equality with X irrespective of scale/representation (JSON number or numeric string). Mirrors Spring jsonPath(...).value(<Double>) (actual converted to Double) and AssertJ isEqualByComparingTo (BigDecimal.compareTo == 0).
expectedConventions.<absent>: Spring jsonPath(...).doesNotExist(): path missing OR value null. The API uses NON_NULL, so the port should omit the property.
expectedConventions.<present>: Spring exists() / AssertJ isNotNull(): path exists and value is not null
expectedConventions.<not-empty>: Spring isNotEmpty(): exists, not null, and not an empty string/array/object (a number is never empty)
expectedConventions.<array>: Spring isArray(): exists and is a JSON array
expectedConventions.<nonblank>: AssertJ isNotBlank(): string with at least one non-whitespace char
expectedConventions.<gte:N>: number >= N (Hamcrest greaterThan(N-1) on an int)
expectedConventions.<compatible:T>: MockMvc content().contentTypeCompatibleWith(T): response Content-Type type/subtype compatible with T (parameters such as charset ignored)
